review_scope: Compared all 23 paired gameplay views on four contact sheets for framing, visible surfaces and material regressions.

images.observation: Table, companion and colored floor patch remain visible under the pendant.
Flashlight pool crosses the tile seam beside the curtain.
Resident, dining table and kitchen fittings remain distinct in the warm room.
Window, chairs and shelving retain their silhouettes against the pink wall.
Sink and cabinetry remain legible. The candidate shows more mottling around the upper edge of the flashlight pool.
Gauge, door and pipe silhouettes remain legible against the dark wall.
Chair and wood shelving read separately against the hallway opening.
Upright duct and brackets remain visible between the tiled walls.
The candidate exposes the lift mechanism and rail beside the jamb. The published comparison looked straight into brick.
The open leaf, switch row and conduit remain distinct.
Brass rail and tiled floor are clear. The recess behind the rail is dark in both frames.
Small orange subject remains visible on the shelf beside the framed portrait, with low contrast.
Wide counter and beams retain the same low-light silhouette.
Mailbox drawer faces and the nearby bench remain distinct in the dim lobby.
Radiator fins, valves, blinds and side table remain visible.
The guardrails and fenced machinery read clearly across the landing.
Tank panels, taper and support frame are visible against the skyline.
The terminal guard edges are brighter and the glowing front remains visible.
Tank housing and wall brackets remain visible against the tile courses.
The colored residue and red tendrils separate from the warm floor.
Upright tendrils remain visible in front of the radiator.
The toaster and canisters are noticeably lighter. The crumb tray and hardware are visible.
The face of the station and its brass key remain visible on the dark wall.
